title: Positive consistency of Naimark's problem and a local hereditary reduction
exact_target:
Is the following relatively consistent with ZFC?

Every C*-algebra $A$ that has a unique irreducible representation up to the
unitary equivalence is isomorphic to the algebra of compact operators on some
Hilbert space.
